1.title: Contact us
1.description: Write us an email at <Link>email</Link>. Tell us about your organization and activities at the university, and we'll answer all your questions.

2.title: Receive a unique link
2.description: After verification, we'll send you a special link that allows your organization to manage events on the PWr Now platform.

3.title: Add events
3.description: Create attractive events with descriptions, images and all the necessary information. Our intuitive interface will make it easy.

4.title: Reach students
4.description: Your events will become visible to the academic community of Wrocław University of Technology, increasing attendance and recognition.

1.q: Who can add events to the platform?
1.a: We currently accept student organizations, scientific clubs, faculty councils and other groups related to Wrocław University of Technology. If you represent such an organization, contact us!

2.a: No, using PWr Now is completely free for both organizations and students.

3.q: How quickly will my event appear on the platform?
3.a: We strive to ensure that your events appear on the platform as soon as possible after they are added.

4.a: Yes, events are verified before appearing on the platform to ensure the appropriate standard and quality of content for our users.

5.q: Can I edit or delete a published event?
5.a: Yes, you can edit event details or delete them from the platform at any time using the organization panel.

6.q: What information can I include about an event?
6.a: You can add a title, description, date and time, location, event category, image, registration link, and other relevant information.

faq.title: ❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about PWr Now

1.question: 1. What is PWr Now?
1.answer: PWr Now is an application for students of Wrocław University of Technology that makes it easier to discover events at the university – lectures, workshops, meetings, sports and cultural events.

2.question: 2. Who can use the application?
2.answer: The application is mainly intended for students of Wrocław University of Technology, but anyone interested in university events can use it.

3.question: 3. Is the application free?
3.answer: Yes, PWr Now is completely free.

4.question: 4. How can I find events that interest me?
4.answer: You can browse all available events or use the search engine and filters to find those that interest you most.

5.question: 5. Can I save events for later?
5.answer: Yes, in the application you can add events to favorites to have quick access to them.

6.question: 6. I can't find an event I heard about. What should I do?
6.answer: Some events may not have been added yet. If you know about an event that's not in the application – contact us so we can add it.

7.question: 7. The application is not working properly. How to report a problem?
7.answer: If you encounter a technical problem, please contact us by email: {email}. We will try to help as soon as possible.

8.question: 8. How can I contact the PWr Now team?
8.answer: The easiest way is to write to us at: {email}.
